analysis_type: Exploratory policy comparison on the existing frozen 28-day test window; not a new untouched evaluation
stress_units: Scaled stress demand is measured in continuous unit-equivalents; it is an assumed demand-proxy sensitivity, not observed item transactions
inventory_policy: Weekly order up to forecast sales over lead time plus seven-day review period, plus a common history-based safety buffer
comparison_policy: Weekly order up to fixed trailing 28-day historical mean times protection period, plus the same safety buffer
safety_buffer: multiplier times trailing 28-day daily-sales sample standard deviation times square root of protection days; heuristic, not a validated 95 percent interval
initial_stock: Both policies start with the same rounded-up historical-average protection stock plus safety buffer
capacity: Unconstrained because storage capacity is unobserved
events: Receive due orders, review/place order if scheduled, fulfil daily scenario demand, charge ending on-hand holding cost and unmet-demand penalty
forecast_extension: Beyond the saved 28 days, repeat the final predicted week solely for protection-window targets; never use future observed sales
cost_units: Assumed scenario cost units, not currency, acquisition costs or demonstrated business savings
terminal_stock: Report ending on-hand and pipeline stock separately; no assumed salvage value or terminal acquisition charge
